type_and_native_boundary_review.error_behavior: Every native BOOL return checked then WinError(last_error) propagates; no zero fill/swallow, no handle or service mutation.
type_and_native_boundary_review.counters: Own-process cumulative IO/CPU/all-thread cycles/faults; before/after nonnegative differences validated, possible wrap/reset fails closed. Memory working-set/peak are raw boundary snapshots, not hard-fault counters.
type_and_native_boundary_review.setup_evidence: Actual captured64bit structures/APIs and2 own-process snapshots PASS. Report bytes/source/plan/runner bindings match. Reviewer did not execute setup; no source freshness claim from setup metadata alone.

timing_and_interpretation.screen: Sum measured66 query bundle wall <=1% sum original33 page wall; predeclared diagnostic observer screen only, not application SLO or proof zero perturbation. If screen fails quantitative attribution invalid with no retry.
bias_limits: Queries bracket but are not simultaneous with original clocks; native deltas include some before/after query overhead and all concurrent process threads.
Boundary observer can perturb cache/scheduling despite calls outside measured interval;1% direct-query cost is not an A/B estimate of all observer effects.
IO counters include logical and non-file IO; not physical disk/source-path bytes. Fault count does not distinguish hard paging. Cycles must not become elapsed time/frequency/instructions.
No native historical counter baseline; cannot retroactively explain earlier tail/profile CPU values or assert platform-wide regression origin.

provenance_and_failure_guards.historical_manifest_scope: 18-helper manifest remains historically source-bound to b2aa. It supplies immutable helper identities, not current75b source binding. Current source/input binding supplied separately by new freeze/plan and runtime guards.
provenance_and_failure_guards.parent_deadline: Original child does not introduce a new overall wall timeout; enclosing owned launcher must retain its approved process deadline and observe real exit. Original future.result calls unchanged.
provenance_and_failure_guards.status_caveat: Native observer credibility describes observer only. Original reservation rawstatus FAIL can coexist with credible sideband; acceptance must check raw PASS/actual process exit and separate current qualification guards. Never treat counter credible as functional/release PASS.
